headline: Open opportunities
subhead: Deals your account executives created. Set SE work status here — v1 keeps status in this app, not in Salesforce.
simulatedViewerNote: Local preview uses a simulated viewer. The published team app uses Cursor sign-in.
sampleDataBanner: Salesforce is not connected yet. This list is labeled sample data so the team can try the dashboard. Add the Connected App secrets, then republish.
salesforceErrorBanner: Could not load opportunities from Salesforce. Status changes are still saved here. Check the Connected App secrets and republish.
allAeBanner: AE–SE mapping is not configured, so every open opportunity is shown grouped by AE. Add mappings in data/config.json when you know which SEs cover which AEs.
unmappedViewerBanner: Your sign-in email is not in the AE–SE mapping, so no opportunities are listed. Ask an admin to add you in data/config.json.
emptyBody: When Salesforce returns open deals, they appear here grouped by account executive.
statusHint: SE status is stored in this app’s database. It is not written back to Salesforce.
_howToEdit: Edit headlines and labels in this file. When you know which SEs cover which AEs, add aeSeMapping objects: { "aeOwnerId": "005… Salesforce User Id", "aeName": "Jordan Hale", "seEmails": ["se@company.com"] }. Match seEmails to Cursor sign-in emails. Until that array has entries, the dashboard shows all open opportunities grouped by AE.
